# Turf bounded distance runtime
Repository https://github.com/Turfjs/turf; @turf/distance/helpers/invariant7.4.0. Official tag v7.4.0 peeled commit22acbd806adb80eece91b7fc43589d5d7788e815. Npm has no gitHead; no provenance invented. Original package archives/hashes and three complete original MIT2017 TurfJS retained by preflight; source MIT2019 Morgan Herlocker also retained. Original ESM copies remain unchanged; adaptation only replaces bare imports with local relative paths, see ADAPTER.patch. No algorithm rewritten. Source maps' complete sourcesContent match fixed Git TypeScript LF-normalized, not a reproducible emitted-build claim.
Only three compiled modules shipped, no runtime tslib/type imports, maps, fonts, GeoJSON user inputs, location requests or network API. No upstream install/build/test scripts executed. Loader is platform native ESM binding. Platform Chinese wrapper accepts finite hand-entered coordinates with up to6 decimal places; latitude±90 longitude±180. Original Turf Haversine mean Earth radius6371008.8m, not WGS84 ellipsoid, navigation, terrain or legal surveying. Shows approximate km/m and TXTJSON; six displayed decimals do not certify precision. Stars10535/push2026-11-04 root snapshot is dated popularity, not quality score. Real phones/all browsers not guaranteed.
